Node.description: A node model with an id

Interface.description: An interface (abstract node model) and a node implementing it

Interface extending another.description: An interface inheriting the fields and label of another one

Union.description: A union of unrelated node models (a relation target, read through db.<name>)

Relationship.description: The properties of every edge of a relationship type ($edge of its @out / @in fields)

Relationship (long form).description: The properties of the edges of a type between two given nodes

Enum.description: An enum (a closed set of string values)

Relation field.description: A relation field to another node (one side is enough)

Id field.description: An id field with a generated default

Full-text index.description: A full-text index over String fields

Composite unique constraint.description: A uniqueness constraint over several fields (also a findUnique key)

Composite index.description: A range index over several fields

Vector field.description: An embedding field with a vector index
